name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by watching WRC events in his hometown. After completing his degree in Logistics Management, he initially joined a local karting team, quickly proving his aptitude for organizing and streamlining operations. His meticulous approach and ability to anticipate potential logistical challenges led to a rapid promotion within the team. 

He transitioned to Peugeot TotalEnergies two years ago, drawn by the opportunity to contribute to a high-caliber racing team. Marko excels at coordinating the movement of equipment and personnel across race locations, ensuring everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. His colleagues value his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to find practical solutions to even the most complex problems. Marko is known for his dedication to efficiency and ensuring that every aspect of the team's logistics runs like clockwork, contributing to the overall success of the team.

Marko's perfectionism is a double-edged sword, driving him to meticulously plan every detail, but sometimes leading to delays as he strives for the ideal solution. His knack for identifying the most efficient routes and minimizing transportation costs makes him an invaluable asset to Peugeot TotalEnergies.
